content.short: Ramp Network is a finance automation platform that helps businesses spend less time and money.
content.description: Ramp Network is a financial technology company that connects the crypto economy with today’s global financial infrastructure. Through its on- and off-ramp solutions, Ramp Network provides a smooth experience for converting between cryptocurrencies and fiat currencies for users in 150+ countries. The platform is integrated with major payment methods, including debit and credit cards, bank transfers, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and more, enabling easy access to crypto for everyday transactions and mainstream finance.
